text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down slightly on the day, with modest selling pressure despite elevated greed sentiment, suggesting traders remain cautious despite positive mood. Bitcoin's dominance holding at 58.7% and total 24h volume near $70B indicates stable but not aggressive conviction, with no clear breakout momentum. The consistency of minor losses across the top four assets—plus flat Fear & Greed over a week—points to a consolidation phase rather than panic or euphoria.
